name: Borgu Fulfulde
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.note: Only variety-specific item on record is Sow 1971 Fulfulde-French-English dictionary (Dahomey/Borgu); no grammar or phonology of Borgu Fulfulde located.

Peace Corps 'Manuel de Fulfulde' / 'Dictionnaire de Fulfulde' are Niger (fuh/fuq); FSI Fula Basic Course is Adamawa/Gombe. sil.org (503), web.archive.org, OLAC, Bing, Yahoo, Brave, Mojeek, BASE, HathiTrust full-text, benjamins.com were blocked or unreachable; OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar rate-limited.

sources.citation: Harrison, Anette Renée. 2004. The use of proper nouns as an index of group identity in Fulfulde personal narratives. MA thesis, University of California Santa Barbara. viii+121 pp. (author's own PDF, Corban University server; SIL archive record 9802)
sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or at Harvard
sources.note: Nothing on word stress. Discourse study of 15 narratives from Niger, Nigeria and Benin; the Benin text KANDI-TROUBLES (Kandi, Alibori/Borgou) is borg1235. Sec. 1.6 'The Fulbe' (pp. 23-25) is sociolinguistic; no phonology. Appendix 6.1 (p. 119): 'Arnott (1965) is the only previous research I am aware of on prosody in Fulfulde in addition to my own work in progress (Harrison 2003)'; transcription marks only pauses, prosodic lengthening and heightened pitch. Cites Harrison 2003 'Prosodic constituents in Fulfulde', UCSB ms (p. 110).
